title: Observe-only bracket advisor: per bar, per live position, log the SL/TP the validated levers / model would set beside the live bracket (Tier-2 PROPOSAL)
note: [2026-10-24 lane ATM-AI-MERGE] PROPOSAL ONLY -- not built, not approved; any PR is a held Tier-2 proposal. WHY: the parity and evidence path before any Tier-3 bracket flip in AI active trade management (Programme 01 section 'AI active trade management'). Today position_path_history (EXIT-PATH-TELEMETRY-LIVE, done) records the live bracket per bar; nothing records what a candidate rule or model WOULD set on the same bar, so harness-vs-live parity of an undeclared lever can only be checked after a Tier-3 declare. PROPOSED SHAPE: phase 0 (no model needed): in the same monitor pass, compute the SL/TP each confirmed-but-undeclared rule lever would set for that leg using the SAME functions as the harness (src/research/trail_levers.py, src/runtime/momentum_levers.py, src/runtime/tp_revision.py) and write advisor_sl_r / advisor_tp_r / advisor_source (lever or model id + version) beside sl_r/tp_r on the position_path_history row (a projection on the same pass; never read by the exit path; never raises). Phase 1: the model output of the first AI-ATM rung that PASSES (09a6-01/03/04, d6e7-06). Read path: the existing diag route for path history. PARITY: the offline harness on the same bars reproduces advisor values (exit-refinement P5) on 1-2 live trades per leg. TIER-2 (runtime writer): prepare + validate, one operator OK, ship, verify. Tier-3 flip of any bracket stays separate and needs an offline PASS plus the advisor parity read. Not on the critical path for rungs A1/B1/C1; it is on the critical path for any live bracket-moving model. OPERATOR DECISION 2026-10-25 ~06:02Z (popup, relayed by Manager Session 2026-10-25 session_016v5FrVaSAmNoz8u6ct9HqC), verbatim: "Build it (Recommended)" — Opus lane, Tier-2 hold PR for manager merge, log-only, no order change. [2026-10-25 lane session_01JYeFjYfLz59wdgNjosriqz] BUILT phase 0 (Tier-2 hold, manager merges): src/runtime/bracket_advisor.py computes, on the position_telemetry history pass, the SL/TP each confirmed-but-undeclared lever WOULD set; position_path_history gains advisor_sl_r/advisor_tp_r/advisor_source/advisor_state (DDL + migration). Registry = structured 'advisor' specs on passed_unshipped cells of docs/research/exit-refinement-coverage.json: trend_donchian_eth_4h RQ-20261016-005/M1 (ADX<20 -> trail 2.5) and trend_donchian_xrp_4h RQ-20261016-015/M2 (ADX<25 -> 2.5). MEASURED (tests/test_bracket_advisor.py, seeded 4000-bar 4h series): 474 managed bars over 41 harness trades, advisor == scripts/backtest_trend.py stop with the lever on within 1e-3 R on all 474; the lever moved the stop vs lever-off on 14 (negative control); dropping the ADX term fails the test. NOT built / out of scope: phase 1 (model outputs); momentum_stale (a close verb, not SL/TP); xrp tp_retarget stall_pull_in (no rule in tp_revision.py). Merged != deployed: values appear only after the trader restarts on the merged sha. 2026-10-25 07:52Z manager session_01XhMPopphHY7qu8H8NqJqqC: #20023 merged (squash fd6b90fb). DEPLOYED: trader + web-api on 495837b72 (contains fd6b90fb), restart_pending false. OBSERVED: 7 position_path_history rows written >=07:45Z all carry advisor_* columns with advisor_state=no_lever (legs mgc/mhg/spy/gdx/iaum/xrp_2h/ada_2h, none advised); envelope advisor_states present.
